func WithStreamSendTimeout(d time.Duration) StreamOption

- Type-safe timeout configurations

func (p Protocol) String() string {
    var parts []string

    if p&Framed != 0 {
        parts = append(parts, "Framed")
    }
    if p&GRPC != 0 {
        parts = append(parts, "GRPC")

    if p&Hessian2 != 0 {

}
